description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveListController class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Leave plugin. The class manages the presentation and interaction logic for listing leave requests, incorporating traits and services for user roles, employee data, leave types, and internationalization. It constructs a Vue component with various properties related to leave statuses, types, date filters, and subunits, and handles authorization to ensure only accessible data is presented.

classes.name: LeaveListController
classes.description: Controller class for managing the leave list view, including setting up Vue components with leave-related data and handling user access control.
